name: NetSuite
shortInfo: NetSuite is the unified business management suite, encompassing ERP/Financials, CRM and ecommerce.
brief: **NetSuite** is the leading integrated cloud business software suite, including business accounting, ERP, CRM and ecommerce software.
about:
DataChannel’s NetSuite Connector enables streaming relevant NetSuite data into a user determined warehouse.

Check more about api documentation [here](https://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/saas/netsuite/ns-online-help/section_1540810951.html#Listing-All-Record-Instances).
availableData:
[**NetSuite Objects**](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/netsuite/pipelines/netsuite-objects.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve a list of all records of a record type.

[**NetSuite Objects (SuiteQL)**](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/netsuite/pipelines/netsuite-objects-suiteql.html)

This pipeline can be used to to access NetSuite records by executing SuiteQL queries.
